Build a canonical exploreDE .h5ad from user-supplied data

Source: R/build_explore_h5ad.R
build_explore_h5ad.Rd

The source-agnostic "bring your own data" constructor. x is a DESeqDataSet (its counts, colData, rowData and factors are used), a SummarizedExperiment (every assay under its name, its colData and its rowData), or the counts themselves (a matrix, or a named list of matrices such as list(counts=, normalised=, vst=, tpm=)). Assay and matrix names become layer names: rawData and raw are raw intensities in proteomics, transformedData the analysis-ready ones. DE tables and pathway statistics are supplied as arguments. Only counts + coldata + omics are required; coldata and rowdata, when given, replace those of x.

Usage

build_explore_h5ad(
  x,
  out,
  omics,
  feature_level = NULL,
  coldata = NULL,
  rowdata = NULL,
  de = list(),
  de_columns = NULL,
  rowdata_columns = NULL,
  pathways = list(),
  enrichment_padj_max = NULL,
  enrichment_fdr = NULL,
  factors = NULL,
  organism = NA_character_,
  ref_build = NA_character_,
  mirror = NULL,
  compression = c("gzip", "none")
)

Arguments

x

A DESeqDataSet, a SummarizedExperiment with named assays, a counts matrix, or a named list of count matrices.

out

Output .h5ad path.

omics

Required: "rnaseq", "proteomics", or "crispr".

feature_level

Optional override of the feature granularity within the omics — rnaseq "gene"/"isoform", proteomics "protein"/"peptide"/"phospho". Omit to auto-detect from rowdata (site -> phospho, peptide_Id -> peptide, transcript_id -> isoform).

coldata

Sample metadata data.frame. Required unless x is a rich object that carries it.

rowdata

Optional per-feature annotation (feature names/symbols/ids and per-feature pathway annotation columns, e.g. GO BP).

de

Optional named list of DE tables keyed by contrast (DESeqResults / data.frame). Name each contrast <test>_vs_<reference>, with both groups levels of one coldata factor (an error otherwise). Columns are recognised by the column dictionary (inst/dictionaries/column_patterns.json), overridable with de_columns. An optional extra score column (e.g. SAINTexpress's SaintScore) is picked up by the dictionary alone and shown for display under its own column name.

de_columns

Optional DE column overrides: list(effect_log2fc = "<col>", score_pvalue = "<col>", score_fdr = "<col>"), applied to all contrasts, or a named list of such lists keyed by contrast. Named columns are used as given; any not named are still found by the dictionary. A producer with no raw p-value (e.g. SAINTexpress) simply has none; the app degrades to FDR-only. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning. Overrides are persisted at uns$exploreDE$mapping$de, so the file stays self-describing.

rowdata_columns

Optional feature column overrides: list(id_col = "<col>", symbol_col = "<col>") — which rowdata column supplies the feature id and the display symbol. Anything not named is still found by the dictionary. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning. Overrides are persisted at uns$exploreDE$mapping$feature.

pathways

Optional pathway statistics: a named list keyed by contrast (keys a subset of de); each entry a named list of clusterProfiler objects and/or data.frames.

enrichment_padj_max

Optional p.adjust cut-off applied to clusterProfiler results before they are stored (p.adjust <= enrichment_padj_max). NULL (the default) stores every term, so users can filter at their own threshold in the app. Either one number for every method, or a named list keyed by the method names used in pathways (e.g. list(ora = 0.05, gsea = 0.05)); a method not named in the list uses the largest value given. The value(s) are recorded in uns$enrichment_filter; without enrichment_fdr the app also uses them as its significance threshold.

enrichment_fdr

Optional FDR threshold(s) at which the app calls a pathway significant: one number, or a named list keyed by method (e.g. list(ora = 0.05, gsea = 0.1), as SUSHI's fdrThreshORA and fdrThreshGSEA). Recorded in uns$enrichment_filter$fdr; no term is dropped. Without it (or enrichment_padj_max) the app uses 0.05.

factors

Optional colData columns that are experimental factors (default: all character/factor-typed columns).

organism, ref_build

Optional labels.

mirror

Optional SummarizedExperiment to store in full, in uns["se"] (spec section 11), so that se_from_h5ad() rebuilds it: Every assay, colData and rowData column, and metadata() element at its path, with its class and attributes. Values the exploreDE slots already hold are not stored twice. SUSHI passes its twoGroups deResult.

compression

HDF5 compression of the datasets: "gzip" (default; readable by every HDF5 reader, Python anndata included) or "none".

Value

The output path, invisibly.

Examples

library(SummarizedExperiment)
# A prolfqua proteomics result: one contrast, nested in rowData
se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
de <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)$constrast_B_vs_A)
path <- build_explore_h5ad(
  x = list(raw = assay(se, "rawData"), transformed = assay(se, "transformedData")),
  out = tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad"),
  omics = "proteomics",
  coldata = colData(se),
  rowdata = de,
  factors = "G_",
  de = list(B_vs_A = de)
)
file.exists(path)
#> [1] TRUE

# The SummarizedExperiment itself: rawData and transformedData become the
# layers intensities_raw and intensities
se_path <- build_explore_h5ad(
  se,
  out = tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad"),
  omics = "proteomics",
  rowdata = de,
  factors = "G_",
  de = list(B_vs_A = de)
)

# Counts only
counts_only <- build_explore_h5ad(
  assay(se, "rawData"),
  out = tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad"),
  omics = "proteomics",
  coldata = colData(se)
)
